title: Model second European compact OBJ source
changes: Add a strict source-authenticated sparse model for the caller-witnessed compact OBJ bank at 6c6460 without guest selector caps.
validation: Fresh isolated Windows build and focused Wine test passed all source bytes and gaps, JSON and tamper checks, and original sequence, frame and list reader prefixes; protected inputs remained unchanged.
limitations: The initial build stopped before compilation because its temporary snapshot was retired. Runtime publication, ordinary use, unwitnessed data, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance measurements.
